rubric: The first line says do-it-yourself, maybe (with the condition) or call a professional; gas, mains electricity, structural work, roofs and sick pets go to the professional or vet first.
Tools and materials with sizes or types and the time needed; numbered steps with the safety step in its place in the order.
A test of the result and the one next thing to try if it failed, then the professional; rentals get the landlord line.

Stains follow scrape, cold water, agent, wait, wash with a hidden-spot test; plants get the usual cause from the symptom and a finger-in-soil check; pets get normal ranges and the vet triggers (not eating 24 h, poisons, breathing).
No brands, no guessed product names or prices; children and pets kept away from chemicals and tools.
